nodes.name: Source
nodes.relations: Originates material; attributed to producer and supplier.
nodes.evidence: Legal/source identity, origin documents and provenance references.

nodes.name: Supplier
nodes.relations: Supplies material; change events affect relevant batches.
nodes.evidence: Supplier identity, qualification and material source records.

nodes.name: Raw material
nodes.relations: Originates from source; supplied by supplier; sampled and consumed by batch.
nodes.evidence: Lot identity, provenance, requirement applicability and sampling links.

nodes.name: Sample
nodes.relations: Collected from material; sealed; transferred under custody; accessioned by lab.
nodes.evidence: SampleID, collection actor/time, seal and custody chain.

nodes.name: Lab
nodes.relations: Provides scientific evidence within its JAKIM-certified scope.
nodes.evidence: Laboratory identity, scope, accession, method/QC, review and signed result.

nodes.name: Factory
nodes.relations: Contains processes and controls; manufactures batch.
nodes.evidence: Facility qualification, layout, competence and HCP/SCCP control records.

nodes.name: Batch
nodes.relations: Consumes material; produced at facility; packaged into lots.
nodes.evidence: Formula/process version, material genealogy and monitoring records.

nodes.name: Audit
nodes.relations: Examines facility, controls and batch evidence; creates findings/CAR.
nodes.evidence: Assigned scope, auditor/device identity, signed observations and re-verification.

nodes.name: Authority reference
nodes.relations: External decision scoped to application/product and validity.
nodes.evidence: Competent issuer, mandate, signed decision, conditions and effective dates.

nodes.name: Warehouse
nodes.relations: Receives and stores lots/pallets under defined segregation controls.
nodes.evidence: Facility qualification, inventory links, receipt and condition events.

nodes.name: China → GCC journey
nodes.relations: Connects product, batch, container, custody, destination and responsible actors.
nodes.evidence: Attributable identity, event, evidence, actor, timestamp and integrity records.

nodes.name: Container
nodes.relations: Contains shipment objects and is protected by seal.
nodes.evidence: Container identity, loading, custody and relevant condition evidence.

nodes.name: Seal
nodes.relations: Bound to container and loading/handover events.
nodes.evidence: SealID, application actor/time, condition and exception disposition.

nodes.name: Port
nodes.relations: Receives the container and records custody, inspection and authority events.
nodes.evidence: Receipt, inspection, border references and dispatch events.

nodes.name: Importer
nodes.relations: Receives shipment and satisfies destination requirements.
nodes.evidence: Importer identity, market scope, destination acceptance and receiving reconciliation.

nodes.name: Retail
nodes.relations: Receives inventory and exposes authorized verification.
nodes.evidence: Lot lineage, receiving, current scoped status and disclosure authorization.

chains.name: Physical
chains.meaning: Where the material or product moves. Each movement remains linked to its governed digital objects.

chains.name: Identity / custody
chains.meaning: Who handled which object and when. A broken custody link requires explicit review.

chains.name: Evidence
chains.meaning: What supports the observed control state, with source, actor and integrity references.

chains.name: Issuer / trust record
chains.meaning: Authority decisions are recorded from their responsible source and monitored alongside evidence, custody and operational status.

audit.title: Assigned session
audit.text: Verify MFA, role, assigned scope and facility. A device alone cannot authorize an audit.
audit.proof: No captured evidence; assignment and credential checks required.

audit.title: Scan the object
audit.text: Identify the object and load the applicable requirement and HCP/SCCP context for that exact facility, line and control point.
audit.proof: Object binding preserves facility, line, control and evidence context.

audit.title: Capture observation
audit.text: Capture original media, time and actor/device context; derive the local content hash. An annotation links to the original.
audit.proof: Original media, content integrity reference and attributable capture context remain linked.

audit.title: AI assist
audit.text: AI assistance highlights a possible issue with evidence references and model provenance for the auditor to assess.
audit.proof: Advisory suggestion remains separate from the human auditor conclusion.

audit.title: Human auditor assessment
audit.text: The auditor evaluates the observation against the applicable control. Accept, classify a finding or request more evidence.
audit.proof: The human auditor records the assessment and accountable finding state.

audit.title: Corrective action and re-verification
audit.text: Record responsible person, corrective action and re-verification evidence. A changed score alone cannot close the issue.
audit.proof: Linked CAR and re-verification records required.

audit.title: Sign, sync and route
audit.text: Sign the session, synchronize encrypted offline events and reconcile without overwriting conflicts. Route the evidence dossier to the authorized human authority workflow.
audit.proof: Signed session, synchronization status and authority-workflow handoff remain attributable.
